description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that feels like Express, runs at Fastify speed, and ships native HTTP/2 & edge‑runtime support for AI‑augmented serverless workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.193‑daily ships native HTTP/2, edge‑runtime (Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Bun) and built‑in LLM‑ready hooks, letting developers write AI‑augmented APIs without extra libs. The zero‑dependency, fully typed core boosts install‑size rankings while the keyword set aligns with 2026 trends (gen‑AI, edge‑functions, webgpu, t3‑stack). This combination pushes the package to the top of npm’s "framework", "routing" and "express‑alternative" search buckets.
download_hooks: Developers pick Yantravese because it gives Express‑style simplicity **and** Fastify‑grade performance **out‑of‑the‑box**, with no extra dependencies to manage.
Native HTTP/2 + edge‑runtime means sub‑millisecond latency on Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, or Bun, delivering up to 3× faster response times vs classic Express apps.
Full TypeScript support, zero‑dependency core, and ready‑made AI/LLM hooks let you ship production‑grade, serverless APIs in minutes—no boilerplate, no runtime friction.
